title: Oven-Roasted Russian Rice Pilaf
description: Tangy and chewy, this classic Russian dish is perfect for special occasions, served on a beautiful Talavera plate.

ingredients.name: arborio rice
ingredients.notes: short-grain rice is best for pilafs

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, ground star anise, and black pepper to the pot and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the arborio rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes, until coated in oil and slightly toasted.
Add the vegetable broth, one cup at a time, stirring continuously and allowing each cup to absorb before adding the next.
If using dried cranberries, add them to the pot after the second cup of broth.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot with a tight-fitting lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender and slightly browned at the edges.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.
